methods.label: Subtract to eliminate x
methods.explanation: The coefficients of \(x\) are equal. Subtract the two equations: \(3y=9\), so \(y=3\). Substitute into \(3x-y=3\) to obtain \(x=2\).
methods.levelReason: Subtracting linear expressions and solving the resulting equations use Grade 7 knowledge.
